title: Fixed a bug in the Ask Flint chatbot
summary: The chatbot was crashing on every message due to an outdated library setting. Tracked it down, fixed the code and redeployed — Ask Flint is back up and answering questions.

title: Insurebot joins the lineup
summary: Added Insurebot to the projects list — an agent that turns inbound broker submissions into clean, structured underwriter summaries, flagging any missing risk fields.

title: Flint Agentic site goes live
summary: Launched flintagentic.com — a hand-built home for Flint Agentic with an Ask Flint chat assistant, a running log of every agent shipped, and short weekly updates on what's next.

title: SOC Analyst Agent rebuilt on the OpenAI Agents SDK
summary: Swapped out the original SOC Analyst Agent for a rebuilt version on the OpenAI Agents SDK. It keeps the same triage, threat-intel and investigation specialists, and adds a human-approved containment workflow plus an offline evaluation suite.
